statement: You are given an array nums sorted in non-decreasing order, which may contain repeated values, and an integer target.
Find the index of the first occurrence of target and the index of its last occurrence, and return them as the pair [first, last]. If target does not occur in nums at all, return [−1, −1].
The search must run in O(log n) time: two binary searches, one that keeps moving left after a match and one that keeps moving right.

examples.explanation: 6 would fall between 5 and 7, but no element equals it, so there is no first or last occurrence and the answer is [−1, −1].

constraints: nums is sorted in non-decreasing order
